items.key: Water that fails in the dry months — the single biggest driver here; one missed month can cost the whole crop cycle, which is the gap between the two irrigated bands above and the two that are not.

items.backtranslation: Water that didn't succeed in dry months — the one with the biggest cause here; one missed month can ruin a whole crop cycle, and the difference between two irrigated ranges above and two not so.
items.problem: "iduse" is not meaningful for "can cost the whole crop cycle"; "likhona elona lunobangela" garbled.
items.corrected: Amanzi angaphumeleliyo ezinyangeni ezomileyo — yeyona nto inobangela omkhulu apha; inyanga enye eshiyekileyo inokulahlekisa wonke umjikelo wesityalo, nokokwahlukileyo phakathi kwemikhakha emibini enkcenkceshelwayo ngentla nemibini engenjalo.

items.key: This plan does not prescribe a fertiliser or pesticide programme. Soil condition, the diagnosed problem, the exact crop and the current South African label all matter; ask a local extension officer or qualified adviser where possible.
items.draft: Esi sicwangciso asimiseli nkqubo yomanyolo okanye yezibulali-zinambuzane. Imeko yomhlaba, ingxaki ehlolwe ngokuchanekileyo, isityalo ngqo nelebhile yangoku yaseMzantsi Afrika zonke ziyathamba; buza igosa lolwandiso lalapha ekuhlaleni okanye ingcali efanelekileyo apho kunokwenzeka.
items.backtranslation: This plan doesn't set a fertiliser or pesticide programme. The state of the soil, a correctly checked problem, the crop itself and the current South African label all matter ("ziyathamba" = are soft/gentle?); ask a local extension officer or a suitable specialist where possible.

items.key: On by default: Auto-suggest may use full, half, third or quarter-bed sections side by side so a long crop does not leave the whole bed blank. These are area shares, not a claimed intercropping row layout; check the section positions on the ground.

items.backtranslation: On by default: Recommend automatically may use parts of a whole bed, half, third or quarter beside one another so that a lasting crop does not leave all the bed empty. These are shares of space, not adjustments of rows of mixed crops; look at the positions of the parts in the ground.

items.key: Field-position ranges come from mapped area and published spacing; they are not guaranteed buy quantities or germination/loss allowances. Supplier and crop-specific guidance may change what to purchase. Botanical seed quantity is not inferred from mature spacing: use the packet's crop-specific direct-sowing rate and germination guidance. Planting-piece ranges are shown only for seedlings, cloves, corms, slips and seed potatoes when both spacing axes are verified. Where a row layout is not verified, confirm it locally before buying material.
items.draft: Uluhlu lweendawo zokutyala luvela kwindawo ebonakalayo kwimephu nakwibanga elipapashiweyo; aluwo mlinganiselo wokuthenga oqinisekisiweyo okanye iimvume zokuhluma/zelahleko. Isikhokelo somthengisi nesesityalo ngasinye sinokutshintsha oko kufunekaukuthenge. Ubungakanani bembewu abuthathwa kwibanga lesityalo esikhulileyo: sebenzisa umlinganiselo wepakethi wokuhlwayela ngqo kwesi sityalo nesikhokelo sokuhluma. Uluhlu lweziqwenga zokutyala luboniswa kuphela kwizithole, amaqhekeza, iikhormu, amahlumela neetapile zembewu xa zombini iimbombo zebanga ziqinisekisiwe. Apho uhlengahlengiso lwemitya lungaqinisekiswanga, luqinisekise apha ekuhlaleni phambi kokuthenga izinto.
items.backtranslation: The list of planting places comes from the area visible on the map and the published distance; it is not a confirmed purchase measure or germination/loss allowances. The seller's guide and of each crop may change what you must buy. The quantity of seed is not taken from the distance of the grown crop: use the packet rate of direct sowing of this crop and the germination guide. The list of planting pieces is shown only for seedlings, pieces, corms, shoots and seed potatoes when both distance measures are confirmed. Where the row adjustment is not confirmed, confirm it locally before buying the things.
